description: Write a small, self-contained JavaScript (Node 22) utility function from a short specification.
input_format: A short spec naming the function, its parameters and its behaviour, including edge cases.
output_format: JavaScript source defining the requested function (no imports, no exports).
eval_criteria: The code runs under Node 22 and passes the example's tests.

seed_examples.input: Write `function chunk(arr, size)` that splits an array into consecutive chunks of `size` (the last may be shorter). Throw a RangeError if size < 1.
Write `function camelToKebab(s)` that turns camelCase or PascalCase into kebab-case: `fooBarBaz` -> `foo-bar-baz`, `HTMLParser` -> `html-parser`. An empty string stays empty.
Write `function groupBy(items, keyFn)` that returns a plain object mapping each key returned by keyFn to the array of items with that key, in input order.
Write `function debounceCalls(times, wait)` that, given sorted call timestamps in ms, returns the timestamps at which a trailing-edge debounced function with delay `wait` would actually fire.
